payload.authorizing_milestone: AGENTS.md fragment-constrained adapter authorization, 2026-09-19, plus explicit user direction to run one deterministic proposal for every frozen prompt
payload.scientific_problem: Measure whether the smallest prompt-conditioned COMPOSE edit-program runner can emit one exact executor-valid, connected completion for every released retained-fragment prompt without an objective or original-drug input.
payload.primary_model_output: One dependency-aware executable edit program and its locked connected endpoint per prompt, or an explicit abstention.
payload.claim_boundary: This is a deterministic zero-oracle support and constraint audit over 50 prompts. It is not the published 100-sample, three-run benchmark, a quality or diversity evaluation, an optimization result, or evidence for a learned controller.

selection.rule: all prompts in frozen manifest order; exactly one attempt per prompt; no replacement, retry, backfill, or outcome-dependent selection

metrics.proposal_coverage: completed proposals divided by all frozen prompts, reported overall and separately for every task label
metrics.constraint_precision: independently constraint-valid endpoints divided by completed proposals, reported separately from coverage
metrics.exact_valid_execution_yield: completed endpoints with matching exact receipt, valid and connected committed states, and independently satisfied fragment constraint, divided by all prompts
metrics.unique_endpoints: distinct canonical endpoints among completed proposals, without conflating this one-sample support audit with benchmark uniqueness
metrics.failure_accounting: report abstention reason codes, independent constraint failures, and unexpected exception types without replacement

prohibitions: no oracle, docking, QED, SA, similarity, quality, or objective call
no Modal launch or live-run access
no T4 or PMO artifact access or modification
no benchmark winner, central drug, teacher endpoint, or original-drug injection
no scored conclusion and no 100-sample benchmark claim
no changing support limits after observing panel outcomes
